units.nameZh: 共同基线把两组日期连成一条
units.nameEn: One baseline holds two date groups together
units.descriptionZh:
年份降为基线下的辅助字，月日成为主线。
两组数字各占一段，靠同一条基线对齐；重复的年份缩小压到基线下方，读者先看变化的月日。
units.descriptionEn:
Years drop below the shared baseline; month and day keep the line.
Two number groups sit on one shared baseline. The repeating year shrinks below it so the changing month and day read first.

sectionsZh.label: 构图
sectionsZh.text: 年份降为基线下的辅助字，月日成为主线。

sectionsZh.label: 方法
sectionsZh.text: 两组数字各占一段，靠同一条基线对齐；重复的年份缩小压到基线下方，读者先看变化的月日。

sectionsEn.text: Years drop below the shared baseline; month and day keep the line.

sectionsEn.label: Method

units.nameZh: 两组宽度按黄金比切分
units.nameEn: Split the two groups at the golden ratio
units.descriptionZh:
左右两段的宽度比约 1 比 0.618。
左右两组之间有一条竖线，从左边框到这条线是一段，从这条线到右边框是另一段，两段长度比约为 1 比 0.618。
units.descriptionEn:
The left and right spans run about 1 to 0.618.
A vertical rule stands between the two groups. The span from the left margin to the rule and from the rule to the right margin measure roughly 1 to 0.618.

sectionsZh.label: 构图
sectionsZh.text: 左右两段的宽度比约 1 比 0.618。

sectionsZh.label: 方法
sectionsZh.text: 左右两组之间有一条竖线，从左边框到这条线是一段，从这条线到右边框是另一段，两段长度比约为 1 比 0.618。

sectionsEn.label: Method

units.nameZh: 用引线把副行撑满主字宽度
units.nameEn: Dashes stretch the sub-line to the main width
units.descriptionZh:
破折号当引线，让副行两端与主字两端重合。
主数字 12.30 下面一行小字，靠两根破折号把字距拉开，左右两端正好抵住主数字的左右边界，上下两行齐头齐尾。
units.descriptionEn:
Em dashes act as leaders so the sub-line matches the figure above.
Under the main figure 12.30 runs a small line. Two em dashes spread it so its ends land exactly on the left and right edges of the figure above, making the two rows flush at both ends.
